description: US employee take-home pay for 2026: federal income tax with the standard deduction (single or married filing jointly) and employee FICA (Social Security 6.2% to $184,500, Medicare 1.45%, 0.9% Additional Medicare withheld over $200,000). State and local tax, pre-tax deductions and credits are not included. US (IRS Topic 751, IR-2025-103), as of 2026-11-22. General estimate for one year: not tax advice, not the payroll withholding.
name: calculate_us_take_home
title: Calculate US take home
